objective: Proof and exact checks. The splitting lemma: in a space made of plane glue and atoms at separate 3-edge cuts, whether removing M creates at a gluing line L depends only on the atoms holding M and L, since every other atom acts as the vertex it replaced. Proved for untouched atoms attached at a point (interface and screening lemmas); for untouched atoms attached at a line the solutions are unchanged and creation is checked. Corollaries: each removal's halo is its atom's halo in the space with that atom alone, and removals in the glue see each atom as in the space with that atom alone. Checked entry by entry, exactly, against the spaces with the untouched atoms collapsed.
status: Proved by NATIVE-GENUS-20261104-001A-P001: in a space made of a base and atoms at 3-edge cuts, whether a removal creates at a gluing line depends only on the atoms holding the two lines, since every other atom acts as the vertex it replaced (proved for untouched atoms attached at a point from the interface and screening lemmas; for atoms attached at a line the solutions are unchanged and creation is checked); exact on 13 designs, 5,130 entries, no disagreement; plane glue alone never creates; halos and sites split by atom; atoms attached at a line have no halo on plane glue
title: The creation map splits by atom
